title: Craftable Horse Armor
description: This Datapack add to your world the craft for they Horses Armors !
body:
🐎 Horse Armor Crafting (1.20.x - 1.21.x)
Tired of exploring endless dungeons just to find a single diamond horse armor? This lightweight Vanilla+ datapack solves the problem by making horse armors fully craftable in your survival world!

Key Features:

Simple & Lightweight: Only adds the missing recipes without bloating your game.

Compatibility: Works perfectly from 1.20.x up to 1.21.x.

Survival Ready: No more relying on RNG loot chests—gear up your horses whenever you have the materials.

How to Install:

Drop the .zip file into your world's datapacks folder.

Run the /reload command in-game.
